The pictures in this project

Each picture is 8 x 8 = 64 pixels. Black = ink (value 1.0), white = paper (0.0). The number under each is the correct answer (the label).

1. The 360 test pictures, one batch of 8 per row

Row "batch k" is what the testbench feeds to the chip in batch k. The chip has never seen these during training.
